name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: Compact step indicator for multi-step flows: done steps show a green check, the current step is a raised pill, upcoming steps are muted.
whenToUse: Wizards such as create promotion → configure → simulate → submit. Put it in the page header actions or above the form.
a11y: Use an <ol>. Mark the current step with aria-current="step". Done steps can be links back.
